---
name: triage
description: Review backlog items and assign phase, priority, type, and readiness labels.
---

Read `docs/tickets.md`, `docs/spec.md`, and `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`. Review the requested issue or ticket for user impact, dependencies, risk, and implementation readiness. Recommend or apply the repository's phase, priority, and type labels using the documented vocabulary. Identify missing acceptance criteria or blockers. Do not change scope without stating why.
